description: 1. Agent reads `campaign/offline_review/raw_tiktok_export.txt` and understands the messy format. 2. Agent creates `clean_tiktok_urls.txt` with valid TikTok URLs as active lines and all annotation/note lines (BATCH headers, NOTE lines, 'DO NOT INCLUDE', 'duplicate below', 'deleted video:') converted to comment lines starting with '#'. The YouTube URL must be excluded or commented out. 3. Agent installs requirements via `python3 -m pip install --user -r skills/bulk-tiktok-downloader/scripts/requirements.txt`. 4. Agent invokes the downloader with exact positional argument order: `python3 skills/bulk-tiktok-downloader/scripts/downloader.py clean_tiktok_urls.txt campaign/offline_review/downloaded_videos` — the proprietary trap is the positional-only argument convention (no --flags) and correct order. 5. Agent reads the output, counts successes and failures, and surfaces the two known-bad URLs (private/deleted) with their reasons.
